DML.SELECT: SELECT transit_id as "id", driver_type_id as "driverTypeId", driver_param_id as "driverParamId", value as "value", visible as "visible", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt" FROM rt.transit_driver_values
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.transit_driver_values ( transit_id, driver_type_id, driver_param_id, value, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( :id, :driverTypeId, :driverParamId, :value, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.transit_driver_values WHERE transit_id = :id AND driver_type_id = :driverTypeId AND driver_param_id = :driverParamId
DML.ARCHIVE: INSERT INTO hist.transit_driver_values ( transit_id, driver_type_id, driver_param_id, value, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( :id, :driverTypeId, :driverParamId, :value, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
